SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.automation

Interface AutomationAddressable

All Known Implementing Classes:
CompressorShaftCalculator, PlatformPowerSystemUnit
public interface AutomationAddressable
Implemented by process units that publish their own variable addresses to ProcessAutomation, for equipment that is not a stream-based unit operation (a compressor shaft controller, a platform power system).

The unit lists its variables with getAutomationVariables(String); an address has the form unitName.property, where the property may itself contain dots (for example "HP shaft.member.K-201.speed" has the property member.K-201.speed). Reading and writing go through getAutomationValue(String, String) and setAutomationValue(String, double, String); a setter that rejects a value (out of range, unknown member, wrong flag) throws IllegalArgumentException, which ProcessAutomation.setVariableValueSafe(String, double, String) turns into a diagnostic JSON result.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim Development Team
